refreshPolicy: Daily at 00:30 UTC (06:00 IST) through GitHub Actions
sourcePolicy: Headlines and links are collected from agriculture news RSS queries. The original publisher remains authoritative.

items.title: Andhra Pradesh declares drought in 21 districts; 283 mandals severely affected
items.summary: The state declaration covers 388 mandals after a major South-West Monsoon rainfall deficit. Farmers should rely on district notices for relief eligibility and local crop advisories.

items.title: Farmers seek water release from Tungabhadra dam to save standing crops
items.summary: Growers have requested additional water release as inadequate rainfall threatens standing crops. Verify irrigation schedules with the responsible local authority before planning field operations.

items.title: Centre approves MSPs for six rabi crops for the 2027–28 season
items.summary: The approved support prices include a wheat MSP of ₹2,610 per quintal. Farmers should check the official crop-wise notification, procurement window and local purchase centre before sale.

items.title: Government sets a lower 2026–27 foodgrain target amid El Niño risks
items.summary: The national target reflects rainfall, soil-moisture and water-availability concerns, with added attention to pulses, oilseeds and balanced fertilizer use.

items.title: India rice output faces its biggest drop in two decades, while stocks cushion supply
items.summary: Rainfall deficits and reduced cultivated area are expected to lower output. Farmers should compare local mandi prices, procurement rules and water availability before changing crop plans.

items.title: Centre clears procurement of pulses, groundnut and sunflower from Telangana
items.summary: The Price Support Scheme approval covers more than 1.25 lakh metric tonnes of crops. Farmers must confirm current registration, quantity and procurement-centre instructions locally.

items.title: రోజువారీ వ్యవసాయ వార్తలు: పంట, వాతావరణం, మార్కెట్ సమాచారాన్ని మూలంతో తనిఖీ చేయండి
items.summary: డాష్‌బోర్డ్ రోజూ కొత్త వ్యవసాయ వార్తలను సేకరిస్తుంది. ఏ నిర్ణయం తీసుకునే ముందు అసలు వార్తా లింక్ మరియు అధికారిక స్థానిక సూచనను చూడండి.
